challenges.description_en: Topsoil washed off cropland and grazing land by rain and runoff.
Concentrated runoff cutting gullies that destroy land and spread.
Nutrient and organic matter depletion that lowers soil productivity.
Too little plant-available water during the season.
Water that runs off or stands on the field instead of infiltrating.
Yields below what the site can support.
Not enough fodder or feed of adequate quality for livestock.
Crop losses to insects, pathogens and weeds.
Loss of tree cover and of wood for fuel and construction.
Steep, bare or overgrazed slopes losing soil, water and vegetation.
Farm returns too low to cover costs and invest.
Acidic soils (low pH) limiting nutrient availability and yield; lime and organic inputs.

objectives.name_en: Soil pH (higher is better on acidic soils; context dependent)
